events.description: Explore thousands of years of London's history through galleries, themed tours and never-before-seen objects. Food, shopping and evening programming extend the visit.
events.title: London Museum opens in Smithfield

events.description: Rescue dogs and their humans walk through central London in Christmas jumpers, ending with a group photo outside Buckingham Palace. Passes raise money for two dog rescues.
events.title: Rescue Dogs of London & Friends Christmas Jumper Parade

events.description: London's friendliest games convention, with RPGs, board games, wargames, miniatures, cosplay and live play. It features the second largest games trade hall in the UK.
events.title: Dragonmeet

events.description: An outdoor winter street flea with 30+ vintage traders on Phillimore Walk. Expect mulled wine, carol singing, festive gifts and street food.
events.title: The Big Kensington Vintage Flea Market

events.description: Skate outdoors in Greenwich's UNESCO World Heritage Site with Thames and Canary Wharf views. Special sessions for toddlers, students and SEND families.
events.price: Adults from £19; children from £16.50; families from £49.95
events.title: The Queen's House Ice Rink

events.description: The 11th Urban Makers Christmas market brings 50 designers each day with handmade gifts and homewares. The Urban Makers Feast serves festive food and drink.
events.title: Urban Makers Christmas Market

events.description: A huge indoor snow globe has landed in Covent Garden. Snowfall returns for the festive season, falling twice a day at 3pm and 8pm.
events.title: Seven Dials Market Indoor Snowfall

events.address: Hawley Wharf, Camden Market, London NW1 8AA
events.description: Curated vintage clothes, retro accessories, rare vinyl and original art fill this open-air market with Bootyfull Car Boot. Walk in free with no booking, across nine Saturdays.
events.title: Camden Market Vintage Car Boot Sale

events.description: Fifty hand-picked vintage dealers sell mid-century furniture, lighting, homeware, posters and vintage fashion. Cafe Thirty-Five serves hot drinks and food all day.
events.title: New Cross Vintage Fair

events.address: The O2, Peninsula Square, London SE10 0DX
events.description: Howard Shore's score plays live under the first film on a 60ft screen. Royal Philharmonic Orchestra and Crouch End Festival Chorus perform for the 25th anniversary.
events.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring in Concert

events.description: Top UK sneaker vendors bring rare trainers, streetwear, street food, live performances and a DJ. Early Entry tickets include a £10 food voucher.
events.title: Crepe City Sneaker Festival London

events.description: Atoui turns the Turbine Hall into a sonic landscape of ancient instruments and electronics. Visitors can sit or lie on stones that vibrate with sound.
events.title: Hyundai Commission: Tarek Atoui

events.description: Watch iconic Studio Ghibli characters all night, with Totoro, Spirited Away and more. Strictly 16+; under-18s need a parent or guardian present.
events.title: Studio Ghibli All-Nighter

events.address: Market Square, Wembley Park, next to Wembley Stadium
events.description: Over 40 traders sell handmade gifts, street food and festive drinks in Market Square next to Wembley Stadium, with live music every market day and a 10-metre Christmas tree.
events.price: Free entry; food, drinks and shopping paid separately
events.title: Wembley Park Festive Market

events.address: Serpentine South, Kensington Gardens, London W2 3XA
events.description: Thermochromic paintings shift with heat and light, and bronze bells ring in changing sequences. Caguiat's first UK institutional show.
events.title: Justin Caguiat: Change Ringing

events.address: Princess May School, Barretts Grove, Stoke Newington, London, Hackney, N16 8DF
events.description: Around 50 indoor and outdoor stalls offer second-hand goods and vintage finds. Toilets and refreshments are on site, and sellers can walk in without booking.
events.price: £5 for early birds from 7.30am; £1 from 9am to 2pm
events.title: Princess May Carboot Sale

events.description: Independent makers sell ceramics, clothing, homewares and gifts at Honey & Co's studio, with mulled wine and mince pies. The founders' own ceramics are on sale too.
events.title: Honey & Co Studio Makers' Market

events.description: The food festival inside The Ideal Christmas Show, with a festive food hall, an artisan Christmas market and cooking demos. Show tickets include it.
events.price: £16 in advance (£18 at the weekend); children £5–£7; £2.99 booking fee per order
events.title: Eat & Drink Festival Christmas

events.address: Ciné Lumière Institut Français 17 Queensberry Place London SW7 2DT
events.description: 40 Gallic films over two weeks, with UK premieres, restored classics and documentaries. Highlights include The Birthday Party with Monica Bellucci and Fjord.
events.title: French Film Festival London

events.description: Wooden Alpine-style cabins line the Thames with gifts from independent craft traders. Mulled wine, churros and raclette are served while you browse.
events.title: Southbank Centre Winter Market

events.address: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Richmond, London, TW9 3AE
events.description: An illuminated after-dark light trail through Kew Gardens, with installations set to music and festive food stops. New adults-only evenings on 3 and 9 December.
events.title: Christmas at Kew

events.description: Three interconnected rinks and a 200-metre skate trail overlook the Thames. Penguin skate aids, festive food and vintage fairground rides add to the fun.
events.title: Glide at Battersea Power Station

events.address: Duke of York Square, Chelsea, London SW3 4LY
events.description: Over 30,000 illuminated white roses light up Duke of York Square for the festive season. Anyone can dedicate a rose to a loved one, supporting The Royal Marsden Cancer Charity.
events.title: The Ever After Garden

events.description: Hokusai's complete Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji, made 1830-1833, is shown in the UK for the first time. Its prints are among the world's most iconic.
events.title: Hokusai: Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji

events.address: Tamagotchi Pop-Up, 60 Broadwick Street, Soho, London W1F 7AN
events.description: Tamagotchi's first UK pop-up marks its 30th anniversary with exclusive shells. London merch, pins and plush arrive, with new drops through the run.
events.title: Tamagotchi Pop-Up Shop (30th Anniversary)
